**Computation (FY2024, year ended June 30, 2024)**

- Revenue: $245,122 million [DOC-1]
- Cost of revenue: $74,114 million [DOC-1]
- Gross margin (gross profit) = $245,122M − $74,114M = **$171,008 million**
- Gross margin percentage = $171,008 / $245,122 = **69.8%**

**Comparability note:** No adjustment issue arises here — the figures are drawn from a single fiscal year (ended June 30, 2024) in a single filing, on one accounting basis [DOC-1]. For reference, the prior-year comparative in the same 10-K (Revenue $211,915M; Cost of revenue $65,863M) implies gross profit of $146,052M, or 68.9% [DOC-1], and that comparison is on a like-for-like fiscal-year and entity basis. Note that Microsoft's fiscal year ends June 30, so this is not directly comparable to calendar-year peers.

ANSWER: $171,008 million gross profit, or approximately 69.8% of revenue
